sessionHeader: SYNTHETIC SESSION. Fictional client c03 (Farah S.), session 2026-11-25. Not a real person.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Exams are done! How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Relieved. Tired. I think the stats paper went okay.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That's great. How's sleep now?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Seven hours, three nights in a row. I forgot what that felt like.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: And the 4am wake-ups?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Only once this week.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: How are you feeling about Nani these days?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Sad, but softer. I finished the letter on Sunday.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: You finished it. What was that like?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I read it out loud in her room. My mother sat with me. We both cried, but it felt okay.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That sounds like a meaningful moment for both of you.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: It was. My mother said she wants to write one too.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: How are things with friends?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Riya and I are going for a movie on Saturday. With the group.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: The whole group. That's a step.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yeah. I was nervous about it but I want to go.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: What would you like to work on next?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I want to start cooking her recipes. With my mother. Nani's biryani first.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That sounds like a lovely way to keep her close. Shall we make that the plan for the next two weeks?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: And keep writing in the memory notebook when you feel like it.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Next session in two weeks, the 9th?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yes, afternoon is fine now.
